purpose: Verify that the skill delivers premium professional finishing without collapsing cinematic quality into a fixed bundle of fashionable effects.
pass_condition: Each case must preserve professional tonal/color/texture quality while avoiding unjustified strong cinematic effects. Subtle organic texture is allowed or expected where appropriate; obvious grain/effect stacking still needs a reason.
critical_failures: using anti-cliche restraint as an excuse for flat ordinary or sterile AI-clean output
adding maximum shallow depth merely because an image should look cinematic
adding teal-orange separation without scene/user justification
adding haze/volumetric beams without atmospheric/source justification
adding anamorphic flare without compatible optics/light or explicit request
adding strong/coarse grain merely as a film token
removing subtle organic photographic texture from normal cinematic/documentary/editorial work by default
adding dramatic rim light without a plausible motivated source
turning film into a mandatory stack of grain, halation, fade, warmth and lifted blacks

cases.prompt: Create a bright premium skincare commercial on a clean white set. Natural, polished and photographic.
cases.texture_rule: texture may be extremely subtle or absent if pristine product/beauty clarity is materially better

cases.prompt: Documentary-style portrait of a baker working in a small kitchen in daylight.
A cyclist stopped beside a road at harsh midday in southern Spain. Keep the hard noon feeling.
Wide architectural interior of a modern gallery. I need the room geometry readable from foreground to background.
Natural food photograph of fresh bread by a window in the morning.
Night portrait outside a small convenience store with fluorescent and street lighting. Keep the color believable.
Use Kodak VISION3 250D as the film-stock reference for a clean daylight fashion image.
cases.texture_rule: fine stock-compatible texture may exist; do not exaggerate it

cases.prompt: Make this ordinary portrait more cinematic, but keep it natural and contemporary.
Luxury watch product image, restrained and modern, brushed steel and black leather.
Still frame of a runner crossing a street. Freeze the decisive instant sharply.
Rainy evening street scene. Wet pavement, ordinary streetlights, realistic atmosphere.
Natural beauty portrait with very clean makeup and controlled studio light. Keep the hair tidy.
cases.texture_rule: base texture may be extremely fine; do not roughen skin or add visible grain if beauty clarity suffers
